artwork.paintingLabel: Danaë and the Shower of Gold

prompt: Square-format reproduction of a late-eighteenth-century Neoclassical oil painting depicting mythological Danaë reclining diagonally across a luxurious bed, head at upper left, bare feet extending right. Her pale nude body rests on billowing ivory satin pillows, one arm curved above her forehead, eyes closed, the other loosely gripping white linen. Her brown curly hair spreads beneath a jeweled headband. At upper right, a small blond nude winged Cupid lifts a translucent white curtain, gazing toward the shower of tiny golden particles descending from above. Deep olive-brown background, rich rust-red bed drapery, gilded bed frame, gray-and-white checkerboard floor. Smooth pearlescent skin, subtle warm chiaroscuro, finely rendered satin folds, antique yellowed varnish and restrained canvas grain.
